# StandardFonts

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides the names of the 14 standard Type 1 PDF fonts.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new StandardFonts()
```

## Properties

- [`Courier`](#courier): Courier - monospace font
- [`CourierBold`](#courierbold): Courier-Bold - bold monospace font

- [`Helvetica`](#helvetica): Helvetica - standard sans-serif font

- [`HelveticaOblique`](#helveticaoblique): Helvetica-Oblique - italic sans-serif font
- [`Symbol`](#symbol): Symbol - symbol font
- [`TimesBold`](#timesbold): Times-Bold - bold serif font
- [`TimesBoldItalic`](#timesbolditalic): Times-BoldItalic - bold italic serif font
- [`TimesItalic`](#timesitalic): Times-Italic - italic serif font
- [`TimesRoman`](#timesroman): Times-Roman - standard serif font
